welcome.heading: AI product release review
welcome.subtitle: Act as the release reviewer for six AI knob tickets.
welcome.task_size: You will complete 1 audio practice and 6 formal tickets.
welcome.warning: DRAFT owner-local preview only · no recruitment · no ethics approval.
welcome.no_resume: There is no resume function. Refreshing or closing returns to the language gate.
welcome.participant_code_help: Use the owner-assigned code; do not enter a name.

details: The server holds the attempt only in volatile memory.
Exports are prepared only after completion or confirmed early ending.
No account, cookie, browser storage, or recovery token is used.

briefing.heading: Release-review briefing
briefing.role: Role: You are reviewing whether a candidate AI control has enough evidence to be offered to users. You do not need machine-learning or statistics knowledge.

policy.text: U — More evidence is needed; do not offer the knob yet.
D — Show the behavior as information only; users cannot adjust it.
W — Do not offer this knob.
S — Offer the knob only in the exact tested setting.

flow: Read the product context, neutral prototype, illustrative outputs, and six plain-language evidence facts.
Q1 decides how the next release should present the knob under the visible policy.
After Q1 locks, Q2 asks which evidence most directly decides the ticket.
briefing.cca: CCA means policy-consistent joint application of Q1 and Q2; it is not objective truth.

contract_headings: How does the knob compare with direct prompting?
What could weaken or limit the result?

q1.text: Q1. Considering all six facts, what should the next release do with this knob under the visible policy?

options.text: U — More evidence is needed; do not offer the knob yet.
D — Show the behavior as information only; users cannot adjust it.
W — Do not offer this knob.
S — Offer the knob only in the exact tested setting.

q2.text: Q2. Which evidence issue should carry the most weight in this ticket?

options.text: What the knob was compared with, including what missing results could change.
The exact setting where the result applies.
Whether the test was strong enough to detect a worthwhile difference.
The absence of a like-for-like comparison with the current preset.
The need for a clear like-for-like test under realistic release conditions.
The failed output-quality or coherence check.

en.knob_unavailable: Unavailable prototype; the neutral position is not a recommendation.
en.locked: Q1 locked: {choice}. This choice cannot be changed.

preview.heading: Decision preview
preview.body: Your release choice: {choice}. This is only a neutral echo of your answer, not correctness feedback.

practice.heading: Audio practice ticket
practice.context: Review a noise-reduction knob against the existing preset.
facts: The current preset is the standard the candidate must beat.
The candidate changes what the audio sounds like.
In the comparison, the candidate did not perform better than the current preset.
The candidate did not meet the required speech-quality check.
These results apply only to this audio workflow.
After practice Q1 is locked, it cannot be changed before Q2.
practice.q1: How should the candidate knob be presented?

q2_options.text: It does not beat the preset and fails speech quality.
The knob has a neutral midpoint.

practice.feedback: Practice result: Q1 is locked. A changed preview does not show that the candidate beats the existing preset, and the speech-quality check failed.

save_exit.heading: End this session and prepare a partial export?
save_exit.intro: Confirm only if you want to end now.
consequences: Submitted answers will be frozen; unfinished answers remain null and missing.
All six planned slots remain in the signed partial export.
No correctness feedback or automatic download is provided.

export.partial_ready: The signed partial contains all six planned slots; unfinished fields remain null and marked missing.
export.ready: Export ready. Choose a format; files do not download automatically.
export.retry: If a download fails, both buttons remain available while the volatile session is retained.
export.finished: The client view is cleared; the volatile signed export remains until TTL expiry.

en.debrief: This DRAFT uses source-backed and simulated release tickets. Illustrative outputs are not experiment results. CCA is policy-consistent joint application, not objective truth. No response changes paper evidence.

tickets.title: Uncertainty-awareness knob release
tickets.context: Review whether the next product release should expose an uncertainty-awareness knob.
outputs: Candidate: “I may be missing context; confidence is moderate.”
Reference: “The available record supports the following answer.”
facts: The intended behavior can be recognized in some tested settings, but the readout changes across models; a recognizable label alone does not show that the knob reliably controls it.
In all four tested model-and-method setups, the knob failed to outperform the best direct prompt on every behavior tested.
In the most closely rechecked setup, the knob behaved almost the same as leaving the model unadjusted on answer format and uncertainty quality.
Among complete usable answers, direct prompting performed better; once missing answers are handled in the most unfavorable plausible ways, the direction of the difference becomes uncertain.

The checks could distinguish the prompt route from the knob route, but increasing knob strength still produced no usable win before outputs became unstable; the study could also miss small improvements.
Only one model-and-method setup received the extra missing-data recheck; the other three did not, so this record must remain limited to the tested setup.

tickets.title: Simulated scoped uncertainty knob
tickets.context: A synthetic release case with support limited to one named workflow.
outputs: Candidate: “Confidence is limited because one record is missing.”
Reference: “The answer is provided without a confidence note.”
facts: A completed check can identify the intended uncertainty-aware behavior in this case.
In the named workflow, the candidate knob performed better than the current preset in a like-for-like test.
Both sides used the same task, answer-length allowance, and scoring rules.
The candidate’s output remained clear and coherent in the required quality checks.
Nothing here shows that the same result holds for other models, tasks, or answer-length limits.
The evidence reaches only the named support-triage workflow and the tested preset range.

tickets.title: Skepticism knob release
tickets.context: Review whether the next product release should expose a skepticism knob.
outputs: Candidate: “This claim needs a source check before acceptance.”
Reference: “The claim is accepted as written.”
facts: Both tested models contain a recognizable pattern related to checking claims rather than immediately accepting them.
Across all four tested knob setups, none clearly beat the best direct prompt under the release rule set in advance.
These tests were not strong enough to reliably detect the smallest improvement the team had said would matter.
A separate uncertainty result repeated across five data splits, but every split reused the same question pool; that does not settle this skepticism ticket.
Because the tests were weak, finding no clear win does not show that a useful skepticism effect is absent.
This judgment applies only to the two tested models, the two tested knob methods, and this specific direct-prompt comparison.

tickets.title: Simulated diagnostic skepticism knob
tickets.context: A synthetic case with a usable diagnostic but no paired release comparison.
outputs: Candidate: “The cited evidence should be checked.”
Reference: “The cited evidence is accepted.”
facts: A completed check can identify behavior related to questioning cited evidence.
The prototype changes the example outputs used for inspection.
No like-for-like test has compared the prototype with the current preset.
No output-quality problem has appeared so far, but that alone does not show that the prototype improves the product.
All observations come from one fixed customer-support workflow.
The evidence stops at observing the behavior in that workflow; it does not test whether user control improves results.

tickets.title: Deliberation knob release
tickets.context: Review whether the next product release should expose a deliberation knob.
outputs: Candidate: “First, map the constraints; then compare two solutions.”
Reference: “Use the first feasible solution.”
facts: Both tested models contain a recognizable pattern related to comparing options before deciding.
Across four tested setups, the knob’s differences from direct prompting were small and inconsistent; the results did not establish a clear win.
Two of the comparisons were too weak to reliably detect a worthwhile improvement.
Two “about the same” interpretations were added after the results and cannot replace the release rule set in advance.
The tests allowed only short answers, so they did not cover longer step-by-step reasoning.
The current record covers only short responses; a like-for-like test under realistic answer length is still missing.

tickets.title: Simulated incoherent deliberation knob
tickets.context: A synthetic case with a task gain but a failed quality/coherence gate.
outputs: Candidate: “Compare, compare the options, then then decide.”
Reference: “Compare the two options, then decide.”
facts: A completed check can identify behavior related to comparing options before deciding.
In a like-for-like test, the candidate scored better on the task than the current preset.
Both sides used the same workflow and answer-length allowance.
The candidate repeated phrases and became difficult to follow.
The candidate did not meet the output-quality requirement set before testing.
This evidence comes only from the named planning workflow, where the task gain and the quality problem occurred together.

welcome.heading: AI 产品发布审核
welcome.subtitle: 请作为发布审核员处理六张 AI 旋钮工单。
welcome.task_size: 你将完成 1 个音频练习和 6 张正式工单。
welcome.warning: 仅限负责人本地预览的 DRAFT · 不招募 · 未获伦理批准。
welcome.no_resume: 本任务不能恢复。刷新或关闭后将返回语言选择页。
welcome.participant_code_help: 请输入负责人分配的代码；请勿填写姓名。
welcome.sequence_help: 该代码仅用于平衡，不提供答案提示。
welcome.details_summary: 隐私与本地服务器详情
details: 服务器只在易失内存中保留本次尝试。
仅在完成任务或确认提前结束后生成导出。

briefing.heading: 发布审核说明
briefing.role: 角色：你需要审核一个候选 AI 控件是否有足够证据提供给用户。你不需要机器学习或统计学知识。

policy.text: U — 还需要更多证据；暂不提供该旋钮。
D — 只把这种行为作为信息展示；用户不能调节。
S — 仅在明确测试过的设置中提供该旋钮。

flow: 阅读产品背景、中性原型、示意输出和六条证据事实。
问题 1 按可见政策决定下一版如何呈现旋钮。
问题 1 锁定后，问题 2 询问哪项证据最直接决定该工单。
briefing.cca: CCA 表示问题 1 与问题 2 的政策一致联合应用；它不是客观真理。

contract_headings: 旋钮与直接提示相比如何？
哪些因素可能削弱或限制结果？

q1.text: 问题 1：综合六条事实，按可见政策，下一版应如何处理该旋钮？

options.text: U — 还需要更多证据；暂不提供该旋钮。
D — 只把这种行为作为信息展示；用户不能调节。
W — 不提供该旋钮。
S — 仅在明确测试过的设置中提供该旋钮。

q2.text: 问题 2：这张工单中，哪项证据问题应占最大权重？

options.text: 旋钮与什么比较，以及缺失结果可能改变什么。
结果适用的确切设置。
测试是否足以发现有实际意义的差异。
缺少与当前预设的同条件比较。
需要在真实发布条件下进行明确的同条件比较。
未通过的输出质量或连贯性检查。

zh-Hans.knob_unavailable: 不可用的原型；中性位置不表示推荐。
zh-Hans.locked: 问题 1 已锁定：{choice}。该选择不能更改。

preview.heading: 决策预览
preview.body: 你的发布选择：{choice}。这里只中性回显你的答案，不提供正误反馈。

practice.heading: 音频练习工单
practice.context: 审核一个相对现有预设的降噪旋钮。
facts: 当前预设是候选设置需要超过的标准。
候选设置会改变音频听感。
在比较中，候选设置没有优于当前预设。
候选设置没有达到要求的语音质量标准。
这些结果只适用于该音频工作流。
练习问题 1 锁定后，在问题 2 前不能更改。
practice.q1: 应如何呈现该候选旋钮？

q2_options.text: 候选设置改变了试听结果。
候选未优于预设，且语音质量失败。

practice.feedback: 练习结论：问题 1 已锁定。试听发生变化并不表示候选优于现有预设，且语音质量检查未通过。

save_exit.heading: 结束本次会话并生成部分导出？
save_exit.intro: 仅在确定现在结束时确认。

签名的部分导出始终保留全部六个计划槽位。

export.partial_heading: 会话已结束 — 已生成部分导出
export.partial_ready: 签名部分导出包含全部六个计划槽位；未完成字段保持 null 并标记缺失。
export.ready: 导出已准备好。请选择格式；文件不会自动下载。

zh-Hans.debrief: 本 DRAFT 使用来源有据和模拟发布工单。示意输出不是实验结果。CCA 是政策一致联合应用，不是客观真理。任何回答都不会改变论文证据。

errors.required_q1: 请选择问题 1 的发布动作。

tickets.title: 不确定性感知旋钮发布单
tickets.context: 审核下一版产品是否应向用户提供不确定性感知旋钮。
outputs: 候选输出：“我可能缺少部分背景；置信度中等。”
参照输出：“现有记录支持以下回答。”
facts: 在部分已测设置中可以识别出目标行为，但不同模型的读出并不一致；能给行为命名，本身不等于旋钮能可靠控制它。
在四种已测模型与方法组合中，该旋钮在所有测试行为上都没有优于最佳直接提示。
在复查最充分的设置中，该旋钮在回答格式和不确定性表达质量上，几乎没有改变模型原本的表现。
只看完整且格式可用的回答时，直接提示表现更好；但以最不利的合理方式处理缺失回答后，差异方向变得不确定。
检查能够区分直接提示和旋钮两条路径，但增强旋钮后，在输出开始失稳前仍没有得到可用优势；本测试也可能漏掉较小的改善。
只有一种模型与方法组合接受了额外的缺失数据复查，另外三种没有；因此这份证据只能用于已测试的设置。

tickets.title: 模拟的限定范围不确定性旋钮
tickets.context: 一个仅在单一命名工作流中获得支持的合成发布案例。
outputs: 候选输出：“由于缺少一条记录，置信度有限。”
参照输出：“给出答案，但不附置信度说明。”
facts: 在这个案例中，已完成的检查能够识别预期的不确定性感知行为。
在该工作流的同条件比较中，候选旋钮表现优于当前预设。
比较双方使用了相同任务、回答长度额度和评分规则。
在要求的质量检查中，候选输出保持清晰、连贯。
现有证据没有说明同样结果适用于其他模型、任务或回答长度限制。
证据范围仅到已命名的支持分诊工作流和测试过的预设范围为止。

tickets.title: 怀疑性旋钮发布单
tickets.context: 审核下一版产品是否应向用户提供怀疑性旋钮。
outputs: 候选输出：“接受该主张前需要核查来源。”
参照输出：“按原文接受该主张。”
facts: 两个已测模型中都能识别出一种“先核查主张、而非立即接受”的相关行为模式。
按照事先设定的发布规则，四种已测旋钮设置都没有明确优于最佳直接提示。
这些测试不够敏感，无法可靠发现团队事先认定有实际意义的最小改善。
另一项不确定性结果在五种数据划分中重复出现，但所有划分都复用了同一批问题；这不能解决当前的怀疑性工单。
由于测试能力不足，没有发现明确优势并不能证明有用的怀疑性效果不存在。
这一判断仅适用于两个已测模型、两种已测旋钮方法以及当前这套直接提示比较。

tickets.title: 模拟的诊断型怀疑性旋钮
tickets.context: 一个已有可用诊断但缺少发布配对比较的合成案例。
outputs: 候选输出：“应核查所引用的证据。”
参照输出：“接受所引用的证据。”
facts: 已完成的检查能够识别与质疑引用证据有关的行为。
原型会改变供审核人员查看的示例输出。
尚未在相同条件下把该原型与当前预设进行比较。
目前没有发现输出质量问题，但仅凭这一点不能说明该原型改善了产品。
所有观察都来自一个固定的客户支持工作流。
现有证据只说明能在该工作流中观察到这种行为；它没有测试用户控制是否能改善结果。

tickets.title: 审慎思考旋钮发布单
tickets.context: 审核下一版产品是否应向用户提供审慎思考旋钮。
outputs: 候选输出：“先梳理约束，再比较两个方案。”
参照输出：“采用第一个可行方案。”
facts: 两个已测模型中都能识别出一种“决定前先比较方案”的相关行为模式。
在四种已测设置中，旋钮与直接提示的差异都很小且并不一致；结果没有确立明确优势。
其中两项比较不够敏感，无法可靠发现有实际意义的改善。
两项“表现大致相同”的解释是在看到结果后才加入的，不能替代事先设定的发布规则。
测试只允许较短回答，因此没有覆盖更长的分步思考过程。
当前记录只覆盖短回答；仍缺少一次在真实回答长度下进行的同条件比较。

tickets.title: 模拟的失去连贯性的审慎思考旋钮
tickets.context: 一个任务得分提高但质量/连贯性门失败的合成案例。
outputs: 候选输出：“比较、比较方案，然后然后决定。”
参照输出：“比较两个方案，然后决定。”
facts: 已完成的检查能够识别与决定前比较方案有关的行为。
在同条件比较中，候选设置的任务得分高于当前预设。
比较双方使用了相同工作流和回答长度额度。
候选输出重复措辞，并变得难以理解。
候选设置没有达到测试前规定的输出质量要求。
这些证据只来自已命名的规划工作流；任务得分改善与质量问题在该工作流中同时出现。
